name: Content Understanding analyzers
summary: Foundry Tools — Content Understanding analyzers with `models.completion='{conn}/{model}'`.
description:
Azure Content Understanding is part of Foundry Tools. Analyzers extract structured data from documents, images, audio, and video via `POST {account-endpoint}/contentunderstanding/analyzers/{id}:analyze?api-version=2025-11-01`. Each analyzer carries a `models` map that binds well-known roles (`completion`, `embedding`) to Foundry model deployments — either inherited from the account-level defaults (`PATCH /contentunderstanding/defaults`) or overridden per-analyzer on `PUT /contentunderstanding/analyzers/{id}`. That per-analyzer `models.completion` slot would need to accept `{connection}/{deployment}` for the BYOM prefix to reach APIM.

Probed in `test.py`: `PUT /contentunderstanding/analyzers/{tempId}` with `models.completion = '{apim-conn}/{deployment}'` on top of `baseAnalyzerId='prebuilt-documentAnalyzer'`. The service either rejects the create because it can't resolve the deployment name, or accepts config-time and fails at `:analyze` time with a not-found on the model endpoint (same shape as `knowledge-bases` and `llm-translation`). Verbatim server response is recorded here once CI runs.
notes:
Content Understanding is not in the official BYOM-supported tools list (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations). Uses `FOUNDRY_ACCOUNT_ENDPOINT` (account-level, not project-level) same as `llm-translation`; the analyzer resource is scoped to the Foundry account. The service invokes the configured `completion` model with its own MSI — the call does not go through the Foundry AI Gateway connection abstraction — so even if the `{conn}/{deployment}` string were accepted at config time, the actual analyze call would need the account MSI to reach APIM directly (a different topology from BYOM, tracked as its own concern). Docs list `gpt-4.1`, `gpt-4.1-mini`, `gpt-5.2`, and `text-embedding-3-large` as the supported completion/embedding models. Update the notes on this card with the verbatim rejection message once `test.py` has run against a live account.

`screenshots/01-defaults-model-picker.png` shows the Content Understanding Studio settings page reporting "No connected resource found" against the test environment used to capture it -- that environment isn't wired to CU yet, so the screenshot documents where the default-model-deployment picker lives in the UI, not any BYOM behavior.
